title: Chapter 54 The Strongest Summoning Technique
content:
Chapter 54 The Strongest Summoning Technique

My wife is indeed a member of the Phoenix Clan.

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly came to Yan Luo.

Looking at this face that was somewhat similar to his wife, Lu Daosheng's murderous intent gradually dissipated.

"Where is your sister now?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

Hearing this, Yan Luo shook her head, "I, I don't know."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's face was gloomy.

"Brother-in-law, this matter is my fault. I brought Xiaoxue back. Can you let the Phoenix Clan go?"

Yan Luo begged at this time.

From the memory of the Supreme Elder, Lu Daosheng also knew that before the Supreme Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan came out of retreat, the Ice Phoenix Clan was still very good to her daughter.

Wrong, it was only the fault of the Supreme Elder.

Then Lu Daosheng sighed slightly and said, "Pray that my daughter is still safe now, otherwise, your Phoenix Clan will surely die."

After speaking, Lu Daosheng left the Phoenix Clan.

In an instant, all the Phoenix tribe members collapsed on the spot.

When the terrifying aura dissipated, everyone realized that they had already broken out in a cold sweat.

Yan Luo looked at the direction where Lu Daosheng left, with a stunned expression.

What Xiaoxue said about being very rich and powerful turned out to be true.

In the end, it was my short-sightedness.

Somewhere in the Phoenix tribe, the two Phoenix tribe leaders and the supreme elder of the Fire Phoenix tribe saluted respectfully to an old man in front of them.

"Ancestor."

The old man nodded.

"From now on, my Phoenix tribe must keep a low profile. The times have changed."

As he said that, the old man looked at the distant sky with a deep gaze and slowly said: "The human race is about to be reborn in Nirvana."

Hearing this, the three were all surprised and doubtful.

In today's Wanling Realm, only a very small number of old and powerful people know how glorious the human race was back then.

.........

The old site of the evil demon tribe.

Lu Daosheng came back soon.

Looking at the bloody evil domain, Lu Daosheng frowned and took out a jade bottle.

Suddenly, the pure wine poured down from the jade bottle and soon washed the dirty land.

"From now on, the evil domain is renamed the wilderness domain, the territory of my wilderness city."

Lu Daosheng murmured.

And this voice quickly spread throughout the entire spirit world.

Countless forces and creatures were shocked.

"Wild domain? What kind of force is the wilderness city? It actually occupied the entire evil domain directly."

"The evil demon clan was just destroyed, and a force suddenly appeared to occupy the entire evil domain."

"Could it be that the evil demon clan was destroyed by this wilderness city?"

For a while, all living creatures discussed it.

However, not long after, another shocking message came out.

The wilderness city is the human race force!

The human race force!

What a joke.

Can the human race also have power?

At one time, countless creatures began to set off for the wilderness, most of them were going to see what the so-called human race was capable of.

A small number of them were human race people who were scattered all over the world, and they had lived in confusion for half their lives.

The emergence of the deserted city undoubtedly gave them hope.

In the Phoenix Clan.

Upon hearing the news, the Phoenix Clan ancestor personally carried a heavy gift and prepared to set off for the wilderness to congratulate.

And in another part of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

Here, the black air was surging, even darker than the former evil realm.

And there was an extremely powerful force here.

The demon clan.

But at this moment, all the demon clan members were pale and their breath was empty.

And all this was because of the blood disaster not long ago.

A disaster that originated from the blood.

That disaster almost wiped out their entire demon clan.

And the culprit of this incident was Lu Daosheng.

The bloodline killing that Lu Daosheng used on the evil demon clan not only destroyed the entire evil demon clan, but also affected the demon clan.

You may be very confused, is the bloodline of the evil demon clan related to the demon clan?

The answer is yes.

Only a few powerful people in the Wanling Realm know about this.

The evil demon clan is a branch of the demon clan a long, long time ago.

To be precise, the evil demon clan is just a failure and a low-level product of the demon clan.

The real demon clan not only has powerful power, but also has terrifying talents. Compared with the endless greed of the evil demon clan, there is no comparison at all.

The demon clan is also one of the top forces in the Wanling Realm.

After Lu Daosheng used the bloodline killing, the evil demon clan was destroyed and the demon clan was also seriously injured.

If it weren’t for the awakened strong man in the demon clan who forcibly used his great magical powers to protect the entire demon clan, the consequences would be disastrous.

"Chief, the deserted city is very likely related to this matter."

A powerful demon said to the chief of the demon clan in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the chief of the demon clan nodded and looked towards the direction of the deserted city with a serious expression.

"In that case, this chief will go there in person. The other party must give an explanation to my demon clan about this matter!"

.........

"Um, no~no, woo woo woo, go away quickly, ah! Daddy, save me!!"

With a shout, Lu Xue suddenly woke up from her sleep.

"Huh, it turned out to be a dream."

Lu Xue patted his chest and slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

However, at this time, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from his mind.

The evil domain became the deserted domain, the deserted city.

Instantly, Lu Xue jumped up directly.

"Dad is here in the world of all spirits!"

"Hahahahahaha, I'm finally free!"

A white bear on the side looked at Lu Xue, who was excited and howling, in confusion, with small eyes and big confusion.

What happened to the lord?

That's right, after being wanted by the Phoenix Clan.

Lu Xue ran back to the territory of the white bear clan.

Although this group of idiots is unreliable, it's good that this place is remote and there are almost no outsiders.

It's safe to hide here.

At this time, Lu Xue, who reacted, was about to pack her luggage.

Seeing this, the white bear on the side said: "Master, are you leaving again?"

"What do you mean again?! I'm going home!"

Hearing this, the white bear scratched his head.

Over the years, Lu Xue has left many times, and every time he would run back in shame.

The longest time was two days, and the shortest was just five minutes after going out.

Seeing the disbelief written all over the white bear's face, Lu Xue gritted her teeth and said, "I'm serious this time!"

The white bear sniffed and didn't say anything.

Seeing this, Lu Xue snorted and went straight to the chief.

"What? Let my white bear clan go to the deserted city?!"

"Sir, why? This place is pretty good."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the chief of the white bear clan was a little reluctant.

This is the territory they had finally snatched.

However, Lu Xue said unconvincingly, "Can you have some ideals? The deserted city is a hundred times better than here, no, it's a thousand times, ten thousand times better. What's the point of staying in this broken place?"

Hearing this, the chief of the white bear clan waved his hand.

"Sir, don't joke, my white bear clan can't stand it."

Hearing this, Lu Xue went crazy.

If it weren't for the fact that the white bear clan had taken good care of him in the past hundred years, he wouldn't bother to care about these fools.

Since soft tactics don't work, he can only use hard tactics.

When she was about to use the treasure to directly take in the entire white bear tribe, Lu Xue suddenly thought of something.

Oh wait, my father has come to the Wanling Realm, so can't I contact him directly?

No, my father can contact me directly.

My stinky father won't forget me, right?

Thinking of this, Lu Xue couldn't help but blush again.

At this moment, she had long forgotten that she had blocked her breath with the hybrid clock.

It's like a girlfriend who has blocked her boyfriend, but still wonders why her boyfriend hasn't come to coax her.

Fortunately, Lu Xue and Lu Daosheng are father and daughter, so Lu Xue will still take the initiative.

Then Lu Xue took out the token Lu Daosheng gave her.

Raised it above her head, she shouted directly: "Dad is coming!"
